title: Concrete Pump Clamp / Coupling: DN80, Gasket, Never Open Under Pressure
seoTitle: Concrete Pump Clamp and Coupling Safety | Pinjin Xingtai
description: Pinjin lists a DN80 clamp, EN 14420-3, PN10 / PN16, 3.5 kg. ACPA: never open a coupling until residual pressure is relieved. Gaskets and pins are inspected daily. Other diameters are quoted against the pipeline, not invented as extra SKUs.

answerBlock.what: The listed clamp is [DN80](/products/concrete-pump-pipe-clamp-dn80/): EN 14420-3, PN10 / PN16, 3.5 kg. ACPA: inspect clamps, gaskets and pins daily; never open a coupling until residual pressure is relieved. Electric 20 prints 80 mm pipe, so DN80 is the matching listed coupling. Electric 15 prints 100–125 mm — that diameter is quoted, not a second clamp SKU on the site. Pinjin does not print a factory gasket life in hours.
answerBlock.who: Buyers matching a pipeline to a listed Pinjin pump who need the one published clamp SKU and the ACPA pressure rule — not a competitor’s full DN chart.
factors: Use the DN printed on the pump page; DN80 is the listed clamp
ACPA: never open a coupling under pressure
Inspect gasket and pin before each pour
Other diameters and quantities are quoted from Xingtai, not invented as SKUs

faqs.question: Which clamp SKU does Pinjin list on the website?
faqs.answer: DN80, EN 14420-3, PN10 / PN16, 3.5 kg. Electric 20 lists 80 mm pipe. Other diameters are quoted against the pipeline after the pump model — they are not extra clamp SKUs on this site.

faqs.question: Can I open a coupling to check a plug while the line is still pressurised?
faqs.answer: No. ACPA: never open a coupling until residual pressure is relieved. Reverse pump or follow the blockage page. Compressed air is not a cleaning method we will recommend from this article.

faqs.question: How often should the gasket be replaced on a Pinjin clamp?
faqs.answer: Pinjin does not print a gasket hour interval. ACPA: inspect gaskets and pins daily; replace when cut, crushed or missing. Photograph the clamp OD and send quantity with the pump model if you need a Xingtai quote — unpublished hours are not a factory spec.
